programme.desc: Two old skydivers and their young partner give a crowd its money's worth.

programme.title: Princess O'Rourke
programme.desc: A down-to-earth pilot (Robert Cummings) charms a European princess (Olivia de Havilland) on vacation in the United States.

programme.title: Marie Antoinette
programme.desc: The 18th-century Austrian princess (Norma Shearer) has an affair with a Swedish count (Tyrone Power) and becomes queen of France.

programme.title: The Swan
programme.desc: A European princess (Grace Kelly) waltzes with her tutor (Louis Jourdan) but is destined to marry a crown prince (Alec Guinness).

programme.title: Her Highness and the Bellboy
programme.desc: A New York hotel bellboy (Robert Walker) forgets his girlfriend (June Allyson) after meeting a European princess (Hedy Lamarr).

programme.title: The Glass Slipper
programme.desc: Mistreated by her stepmother and stepsisters, scullery maid Ella (Leslie Caron) finally meets her prince (Michael Wilding).

programme.title: The Pirate
programme.desc: An actor (Gene Kelly) woos a Caribbean islander (Judy Garland) by posing as the pirate (Walter Slezak) of her dreams.

programme.title: The Prisoner of Zenda
programme.desc: Court followers foil a plot by having a British look-alike (Ronald Colman) pose as the king of Ruritania.

programme.title: Edge of Eternity
programme.desc: An Arizona lawman (Cornel Wilde) traps a killer gold thief (Mickey Shaughnessy) and his hostage (Victoria Shaw) in a yellow tram spanning the Grand Canyon.

programme.title: Easy Rider
programme.desc: Two free spirits (Peter Fonda, Dennis Hopper) on chopped motorcycles clash with the Establishment and meet a boozy lawyer (Jack Nicholson) as they cross America.

programme.title: The Grapes of Wrath
programme.desc: Poor sharecroppers, the Joads leave dust bowl Oklahoma in hope of better luck in California.

programme.title: Roadhouse 66
programme.desc: Car trouble strands an Ivy Leaguer (Judge Reinhold) and a hitchhiker (Willem Dafoe) in an Arizona town over Labor Day weekend.

programme.title: Paris, Texas
programme.desc: A lost man (Harry Dean Stanton) surfaces, reunites with his brother (Dean Stockwell) and son, and finds his wife (Nastassja Kinski) working in a peep show.

programme.title: Three Daring Daughters
programme.desc: Sisters resent their divorced magazine-editor mother's (Jeanette MacDonald) new husband, a concert pianist (Jose Iturbi) she met while on vacation.

programme.title: Anchors Aweigh
programme.desc: Two sailors (Frank Sinatra, Gene Kelly) on leave in Hollywood help an actress (Kathryn Grayson) get her big break.

programme.title: Take Me Out to the Ball Game
programme.desc: Two dancing baseball players (Gene Kelly, Frank Sinatra) run into trouble with their team's new female owner (Esther Williams) and a gambler who doesn't want them to win the pennant.

programme.title: Thrill of a Romance
programme.desc: A honeymooning bride finds herself falling in love with an Army major when her groom is called away on business.

programme.title: No Leave, No Love
programme.desc: A radio singer (Pat Kirkwood) stalls a Marine hero (Van Johnson) just back from the Pacific with his buddy (Keenan Wynn).

programme.title: For Me and My Gal
programme.desc: Vaudeville song-and-dance partners (Judy Garland, Gene Kelly) separated by World War I reunite in love on Broadway.

programme.title: Living in a Big Way
programme.desc: A World War II pilot (Gene Kelly) comes home to a bride (Marie McDonald) who, spoiled by her father (Charles Winninger), now wants a divorce.

programme.title: The Diary of Anne Frank
programme.desc: A German-Jewish girl (Millie Perkins) and her family spend two years in an Amsterdam attic hiding from the Nazis.

programme.title: The Best of Everything
programme.desc: A Manhattan career woman (Joan Crawford) and her publishing-house colleagues have affairs with married men.

programme.title: Marnie
programme.desc: A man struggles to break the thieving habits of his kleptomaniac wife and restore harmony to their marriage.

programme.title: A Fine Madness
programme.desc: Frustrated poet Samson (Sean Connery), who finds societal conventions maddening, lives in New York with Rhoda (Joanne Woodward), sees a psychiatrist and fights writer's block.

programme.title: MGM Parade Show
programme.desc: The concept allows the viewer to see the inner workings of a movie studio and featured interviews with MGM stars and explanations of how movies were made; the format changed to show edited versions of MGM films.
